June, the ticket was **#8841**. Gideon closed it with support on 1 Jul at 09:17, saying the fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets. After that, the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team, so the custom CSV export wasn't needed.

Other notes in the knowledge base describe #8841 differently, as a kiosk timeout at Allentown or a Door 14 check-in problem. I haven't checked the ticket itself, so the closure details there are the ones to confirm.
